notes:
## Watch with Silo

Open the Silo card, enter your server address and sign in. Use the arrows to browse Continue Watching, press OK to resume an episode, and use the player controls to choose audio and subtitles. Back returns to the selected poster. Home pauses playback and returns to Canapey. The dedicated full-screen window remembers your session.

## Library and controls

- Add a website under **Library → Add → Add website**. Choose a name and optional artwork. Website cards open in the Windows default browser.
- Navigation sound preferences now stay in sync across browser preview tabs.
- The iPhone Companion receiver preserves positive transaction identifiers in replies to remote and keyboard commands.

## Installation and validation

Download the Windows x64 installer below, or open **Settings → Updates → Check for updates** in an updater-enabled installation. The experimental update carries a Tauri signature. The release includes the installer checksum.

The Silo playback flow was exercised with the real server in Chrome, including audio, subtitles and returning to the selected poster. Full-screen playback and remote buttons still need a hands-on check with WebView2 on a Windows PC.
